Péter Juhász, PhD

Quantitative Researcher

Summary

I am a PhD researcher in Mathematics with experience in stochastic modeling, probabilistic analysis, and large-scale simulation, supported by Python/C++ model development. Previously, I worked as a machine learning researcher at Bosch, where I developed and validated predictive models with a focus on uncertainty estimation and data-driven decision-making. I am interested in applying quantitative methods to forecasting and risk modeling in energy and financial markets.

Experience

Researcher in Probability

Aarhus University

November 2022 – December 2025
  • Developed stochastic models to analyze and predict structural and statistical properties of dynamic real-world systems.
  • Designed statistical validation methods to rigorously evaluate model assumptions and predictions against empirical observations.
  • Built large-scale Monte Carlo simulations and algorithms in Python and C++ to stress-test models, evaluate edge cases, and quantify uncertainty.
  • Presented research at international conferences in probability, stochastic modeling, and data analysis.
  • Taught advanced probability, data analysis, and differential equations to mathematics and data-science students.

Machine Learning Researcher in Automated Driving

Bosch Group Hungary

May 2018 – October 2022
  • Patented a Gaussian regression-based trajectory prediction model, improving predictive accuracy by 3x and uncertainty calibration by 10x over production baselines.
  • Built stochastic forecasting and uncertainty quantification models in Python for safety-critical, real-time decision-making in automated driving.
  • Translated Python prototypes into scalable C++ systems with explicit reliability criteria.
  • Designed and executed large-scale data analyses and validation experiments to evaluate model assumptions and predictions against observed outcomes.
  • Led a team of 11 developing, validating, and integrating environment prediction models for automated driving as a technical lead.
  • Oversaw 2 teams in the integration of driver monitoring systems.

Software Engineer for Mobile Networks

Ericsson Telecommunications Hungary

March 2016 – May 2018
  • Optimized load-balancing strategies by analyzing response times of distributed systems.
  • Implemented performance-critical algorithms for mobile networks.
  • Coordinated a team of 8 as a deputy of the product owner.
